title: Cyberpunk 2077
description: An open-world action-adventure RPG set in Night City, a megalopolis obsessed with power, glamour and body modification.

title: Helldivers 2
description: A third-person squad-based shooter where players fight intergalactic threats for Freedom across the galaxy.

title: Stardew Valley
description: A cozy farming simulation RPG where you inherit your grandfather's old farm plot and build a new life.

title: Deep Rock Galactic
description: A 1-4 player co-op FPS featuring badass space Dwarves, 100% destructible environments, procedural caves, and alien hordes.

title: Elden Ring
description: A fantasy action-RPG epic focused on tactical combat, vast open-world exploration, and challenging boss battles.

title: Subnautica
description: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril. Craft equipment, pilot submarines and outsmart wildlife.

title: Slay the Spire
description: Fuse deck-building with roguelike mechanics to craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power.

title: Doom Eternal
description: Hell's armies have invaded Earth. Become the Slayer in an epic single-player campaign to conquer demons across dimensions.

title: Phasmophobia
description: A 4-player co-op psychological horror where you and your team members enter haunted locations filled with paranormal activity.

title: Forza Horizon 5
description: Your ultimate Horizon Adventure awaits! Explore the vibrant open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action.

title: Dead Space
description: A sci-fi survival horror classic rebuilt from the ground up to offer a deeper and more immersive experience on a mining spaceship.

title: Factorio
description: Build and maintain factories. Mine resources, research technologies, build infrastructure, automate production, and fight enemies.

title: Valheim
description: A brutal exploration and survival game for 1-10 players set in a procedurally-generated purgatory inspired by Norse mythology.

title: Portal 2
description: An inventive puzzle adventure featuring mind-bending portal physics, single-player storyline, and a dedicated co-op campaign.

title: Left 4 Dead 2
description: Set in the zombie apocalypse, Left 4 Dead 2 is the highly anticipated sequel to the award-winning co-op shooter.

title: Hades
description: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash your way out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler from Supergiant Games.

title: Terraria
description: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game with endless 2D crafting and building.

title: Outer Wilds
description: An open world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop. Explore dangerous planets and unearth ancient secrets.

title: Rust
description: The only aim in Rust is to survive. Overcome struggles such as hunger, thirst and cold. Build a fire. Build a shelter. Kill animals for meat.

title: Cyber Neon: Zero Gravity
description: A neon-drenched futuristic cyberpunk racing simulator with zero gravity physics and customization.
